entry.description: Number of the experiment in `experiments` (1 = first)

results.description: Numbers of this reaction's results in the experiment's `results` (1 = first); empty when it states none

variant.description: Key of the experiment's variant (run) this reaction is; null when it has none

footnote_markers.description: Markers of the experiment that apply to this reaction

distinguishing.description: Only when the experiment reports more than one reaction: what sets this one apart, as the passage says it; else null

participant_keys.description: The participants of the experiment that carry the symbol

variables.description: Values of variable groups printed for this reaction ('X = Cl'); empty as a rule

reactions.description: Every reaction of the passage in experiment order: one per experiment, or one per run of an experiment that has variants

notes.description: Why an experiment was split, or what is unusual about it; nothing for plain experiments

issues.description: Doubts a reviewer should look at
